天刚破晓，东方泛起鱼肚白。

江南749局总部的后山营地，晨雾缭绕，灵气氤氲。八人特战小队早已整装完毕，列队站在青石广场之上。

胡九郎一身黑衣背负布包，神色淡漠沉静，周身不露半点波澜；范梦雪素白道袍衬得身姿清冷，雷道灵气隐隐内敛；王欣欣、茉沫一身劲装，暗器暗扣随身，眼神警惕如鹰；李安琪温婉静立，指尖萦绕细碎金芒；钱丹苗疆衣裙素雅，袖中蛊虫安静蛰伏；杨瑞神色孤寂，手中提着一只古朴炼器木箱；林佳一身制式白衣，手握情报平板，神情肃穆。

全员气息收敛，战意暗藏，没有多余言语，只等着出发号令。

不多时，两辆黑色特种越野车缓缓驶入营地，车身通体哑光，隐有阵法纹路流转，是749局专门调配的后勤专车，可隐匿灵气、隔绝探查，专门接送高阶修士执行绝密任务。

“各位，请上车。”林佳侧身抬手，语气沉稳，“先前往隐秘物资专线列车，全程不走民用轨道，直穿数省，直达东北沈阳749局分局，中途不做停留。”

众人依次登车。

胡九郎与范梦雪同坐后座，车窗封闭，隔绝外界视线。车子平稳驶出营地，穿行山林小路，绕开城市主干道，一路朝着隐秘军用站台而去。

车厢内气氛安静，没人随意开口。

范梦雪侧头看向窗外飞速倒退的山林树影，忍不住轻声开口：“胡师兄，东瀛甲贺忍最擅潜行幻术，隐匿刺杀于无形，寻常修士极易陷入幻境，分不清虚实。你精通阵法符箓，可有提前防备之法？”

胡九郎闭目靠在座椅上，闻声缓缓睁眼，眸色清冷：“甲贺幻术脱胎于东瀛阴阳遁术，以心神迷惑、光影错位为根基，看似玄妙，实则离不开阴煞气场加持。”

他抬手指尖轻点车窗，一缕微弱道纹悄然浮现：“我可在列车周身布下简易镇幻符阵，隔绝外界阴煞侵入，稳住众人心神。只要道心不乱，意志坚定，低级幻术便无从近身。”

范梦雪微微颔首，心底暗自佩服。

龙虎山符箓之道果然名不虚传，随手之间便可布下护阵，比起神霄派正面雷法镇压，多了几分润物细无声的稳妥。

“东北极寒，长白山一带磁场紊乱，罗盘失灵，风水错位，到时候还要劳烦师兄以命格推演引路。”范梦雪客气道。

“分内之事。”胡九郎淡淡回了六个字，再度闭目养神，不再多言。

范梦雪见他性子清冷寡言，也不再主动搭话，安静望向窗外，暗自调息运转雷法，养精蓄锐，为前路厮杀做准备。

半个时辰后，车辆抵达深山之中的隐秘专线站台。

没有人群喧嚣，没有客运标识，只有一条漆黑延伸的铁轨静静卧在山林之间。一列通体墨色的专属列车静静停靠，车身刻满禁制纹路，灵气封锁，煞气不侵，是749局专门用来运送修士、异能者的专属专列。

众人下车，依次登上列车包厢。

The sky has just broken, and the fish belly is white in the east.

In the back mountain camp of the Jiangnan 749 Bureau headquarters, the morning mist is shrouded and the spirit is dense.The eight-man special operations team had already been fully equipped and stood in formation on the Bluestone Square.

Hu Jiulang was dressed in black and carried a cloth bag on his back, with an indifferent and calm expression, not showing any waves; Fan Mengxue's plain white Taoist robe made her figure cold, and her Lei Dao aura was faintly restrained; Wang Xinxin and Momo were dressed in smart clothes, carrying concealed weapons with them, and their eyes were as alert as eagles;Li Anqi stood gently and quietly, with fine golden light lingering on her fingertips; Qian Dan Miaojiang's dress was simple and elegant, and the poisonous insects in his sleeves were dormant quietly; Yang Rui looked lonely, holding a simple wooden box for refining weapons in his hand; Lin Jia was dressed in standard white clothes, holding an information tablet in his hand, with a solemn expression.

All members' auras were restrained, their fighting spirit was hidden, and they had no unnecessary words, just waiting for the order to set off.

Not long after, two black special off-road vehicles slowly drove into the camp. Their bodies were matte, with hidden formation patterns. They were logistics vehicles specially deployed by the 749 Bureau. They could conceal spiritual energy, isolate detection, and were specially designed to transport high-level monks to perform top-secret missions.

"Everyone, please get on the train." Lin Jia raised her hand sideways and said in a calm tone, "Let's go to the hidden material special train first. It does not use civilian tracks throughout the journey. It goes straight through several provinces and reaches the 749 Bureau branch in Shenyang, Northeast China, without any stops on the way."

Everyone boarded the car one by one.

Hu Jiulang and Fan Mengxue were sitting in the back seat together, with the windows closed to block outside sight.The car drove smoothly out of the camp, passed through the mountain roads, bypassed the city's main roads, and headed all the way towards the hidden military station.

The atmosphere in the carriage was quiet, no one spoke casually.

Fan Mengxue turned her head to look at the rapidly retreating forest trees outside the window, and couldn't help but speak softly: "Brother Hu, the Japanese Jiahe Ninja are best at sneaking illusions, hiding and assassinating invisible. Ordinary monks can easily fall into illusions and cannot distinguish reality from reality. You are proficient in formations and talismans, do you have any way to prepare in advance?"

Hu Jiulang closed his eyes and leaned on the seat. After hearing the sound, he slowly opened his eyes with a cold look in his eyes: "Jiahe illusion was born out of the Japanese Yin and Yang escape technique. It is based on the confusion of the mind and the misalignment of light and shadow. It seems mysterious, but in fact it is inseparable from the blessing of the Yin evil aura."

He raised his fingertips and tapped on the window, and a faint Dao pattern quietly emerged: "I can place a simple illusion-suppressing talisman array around the train to isolate the evil spirits from the outside world and stabilize everyone's minds. As long as the Dao mind is not chaotic and the will is firm, low-level illusions will not be able to get close."

Fan Mengxue nodded slightly, secretly admiring her in her heart.

The Longhu Mountain Talisman Technique is indeed well-deserved. It can lay out protective formations at will. Compared with the frontal thunder method of the Shenxiao Sect to suppress it, it is a little more moisturizing and silent.

"It's extremely cold in the Northeast, the magnetic field in the Changbai Mountain area is disordered, the compass is malfunctioning, and the Feng Shui is misaligned. When the time comes, I'll have to trouble my senior brother to lead the way with destiny deductions." Fan Mengxue said politely.

"It's a matter of duty." Hu Jiulang replied with six words, closed his eyes again to rest, and said no more.

Fan Mengxue saw that he was cold-tempered and taciturn, so she no longer took the initiative to talk to him. She quietly looked out the window, secretly adjusting her breath and running her thunder skills, recharging her energy and preparing for the fight ahead.

Half an hour later, the vehicle arrived at the secret line platform deep in the mountains.

There is no crowd noise, no passenger signs, only a dark extending railway track lying quietly among the mountains and forests.An exclusive train, all in black, stopped quietly. Its body was engraved with forbidden lines, and the aura was blocked to prevent evil spirits from invading. It was an exclusive train specially used by Bureau 749 to transport monks and people with supernatural powers.

Everyone got off the train and boarded the train compartments one by one.
